fr.operationFailed: L'opération n'a pas abouti. Consultez le message ci-dessus.
fr.helpText:
1. Fermez SnowRunner et choisissez Installer le correctif.
   Les vérifications de compatibilité sont automatiques.
2. Une fois installé, jouez normalement depuis Steam.
3. Revenez ici pour consulter l'état, désactiver ou désinstaller.

Le dossier extrait peut être déplacé. Gardez Sources avec Install.cmd.
Une mise à jour inconnue du jeu laisse la correction inactive.
Guide détaillé : Sources\README.fr.md

en.title: SnowRunner — Force feedback fix
en.returnPrompt: Press Enter to return to the menu.
en.directoryPrompt: Paste the game folder or Sources\Bin.
en.directoryReset: Press Enter without a path to restore automatic detection:
en.operationFailed: The operation did not complete. See the message above.
en.helpText:
1. Close SnowRunner and choose Install the fix.
   Compatibility checks run automatically.
2. Once installed, launch the game normally from Steam.
3. Return here to view status, disable or uninstall.

You can move the extracted folder. Keep Sources next to Install.cmd.
An unknown game update leaves the fix inactive.
Detailed guide: Sources\README.en.md
en.notRegular: This path is not a regular file: {0}
en.notFound: SnowRunner was not found. Use More options to choose the game folder.
en.missingExe: SnowRunner.exe was not found in the selected folder: {0}
en.reparsePath: The path uses an unsupported folder redirection: {0}
en.unexpectedFilename: The package contains an unexpected installation filename.
en.escapedPath: The target file is outside the selected game folder.
